pitch_velo.about: HS / travel pitch kind x velocity (Drew's ruling 4), exported by hitter_data.fit_count_hs.pitch_table from the fit that gained +0.0104 nats per pitch on 2025 (FITS_COUNT_v13 12.2, stack kind + velo_rel + velo_abs), refit on 2022-2025 on top of hs_sep_thru2025. Each term multiplies the pitch's six event probabilities (outcomes) at its count and renormalises: P(y) ~ P_engine(y) x kind[count][kind][y] x velo_rel[count][class][bin][y] x velo_abs[count][class][bin][y]. A velocity term is skipped when the pitch has no entered speed (the fit's missing-data rule).
